policy.selectionRule: Preflight GO/READY candidates only; highest finalScore first.
policy.machineIdPolicy: Do not invent machineId at dispatch time. Formal machine authentication during full research assigns it.
policy.usagePolicy: Only one full-research candidate is active at a time. Others remain queued.
